contacts.label: Help Desk Location
contacts.value: Yellow tents at the Graduation Arena entrance

faqs.question: How do I find my name on the graduands list?
faqs.answer: Open Graduands, then filter by your study level and programme. You can also search by name in real time.

faqs.question: What time should I arrive?
faqs.answer: Graduands should arrive by 07:00 for assembly. Guests are advised to be seated by 08:00. See the Timetable page for the full schedule.

faqs.question: Where do I collect my gown?
faqs.answer: Follow faculty notices for gown collection. On ceremony day, final checks are done at the Main Campus Quadrangle.

faqs.question: How do I watch the ceremony online?
faqs.answer: Open Live Ceremony, choose Graduation Day or Convocation Day, then watch on the page or open in YouTube.

faqs.question: Who are the best students?
faqs.answer: Visit Best Students to see recognised top performers by programme and award.

faqs.question: I cannot find a venue on campus.
faqs.answer: Use the Venue Guide to pick From and To locations, then open the route in Maps.
